applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Asset Liability Management) Second Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks must update their references for LCR and NSFR disclosure templates to the specified capital adequacy and financial statements directions.
answer.action_quote: For LCR disclosure template and related instructions, a bank shall refer to relevant instructions in Reserve Bank of India

effective_date.quote: The above amendments shall come into force from April 1, 2027.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Asset Liability Management) Directions, 2025
